title: Looking at the Laboratory Discussion: Course Modality Choice and Student Performance in Organic Chemistry
reason: Institutional records: logistic regression of online vs face-to-face lab-discussion enrolment and hierarchical regression of lab grades on modality and student characteristics. Modality is group membership; no per-student LMS activity measure enters the models.

extraction.design: correlational (logistic and hierarchical regression on institutional data)
extraction.n_quote: This study consisted of a total of 2,226 students (n = 1,402
extraction.population: organic chemistry course-sequence students at a US AANAPISI university, 2015-2017
extraction.outcome_or_construct: organic chemistry laboratory performance (grade); choice of online LD
extraction.notes: Online vs face-to-face modality effect on lab performance is a format comparison, not an indicator-outcome relation.
